summary: Cluster autoscaler Location Policy lets users choose between two spreading policies for autoscaled node pools.
extended_definition: Cluster autoscaler Location Policy lets users choose between two spreading policies for autoscaled node pools.

supporting_pages.title: "About GKE cluster autoscaling \_|\_ Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE) \_|\_\
evidence_snippets: You can control the cluster autoscaler distribution policy by specifying the location policy flag with any of the following values: BALANCED : this policy instructs the cluster autoscaler to distribute node pool resources across selected zones as equally as possible, in the best effort manner, while considering Pod requirements (such as affinity) and the availability of resources.
ProvisioningRequest CRD A ProvisioningRequest is a namespaced custom resource that lets users request capacity for a group of Pods from the cluster autoscaler.
Location policy Starting in GKE version 1.24.1-gke.800, you can change the location policy of the cluster autoscaler.
